CustomField.description: Whether this supplier's compliance case is still active or has been formally closed by an Analyst (VendorPortalController.closeComplianceCase). Distinct from Onboarding_Status__c, which tracks WHERE the account is in the onboarding pipeline (Draft/Screening/In Review) — this tracks whether the CASE itself is done. 'Open' is the only value both getAnalystQueue and getScreeningQueue filter on to remove a case from both queues once closed.
CustomField.label: Compliance Case Status
